description.value: Deadbeetz Burgers is a locally focused fast-food burger spot on Oak Bay Avenue in Victoria, built around house-made ingredients like pickled beets, dill pickles, and a signature Vancouver Island sauce. The menu spans beef, breaded chicken, grilled Alaskan salmon, and fully plant-based patties, making it one of the more diverse quick-service stops in the neighbourhood. Online ordering with pickup is available, and a small dessert and drinks menu rounds out the offering for a full refuelling stop.
